value.rationale: A canonical regular four-polytope is reduced at both nontrivial finite thresholds with optimal integer-Morse cell counts. In contrast to previously published Betti numbers, the claim supplies 887 exact free face-pair removals, proves no residual attaching maps, and concretely answers the four-polytope homotopy challenge using a reproducible minimal CW model. This is not a general family theorem; the strength is the object-motivated perfect-Morse property, not numerical novelty.
